own_solution.law: Conical pendulum: T cos(theta) = m g, T sin(theta) = m omega^2 L sin(theta), so omega^2 = g/(L cos theta) and period P = 2 pi sqrt(L cos theta / g).

notes: L cos 30 = 1.2*0.866025 = 1.03923 m; /9.8 = 0.106044 s^2; sqrt = 0.325644 s; P = 2.0461 s. With L = 1.9 m: 1.645448/9.8 = 0.167903, sqrt = 0.409760, P = 2.5746 s. Mass cancels between tension, weight and centripetal force, so C. Earlier-experiment sentences and second-bob sentences have no path to the present period. All numeric 0.7 m sentences match; 'short length' sentences are numeral-free; both mass sentences give 1.4 kg. Minor wording point: several sentences say 'the bob' while the scene has two bobs; the base text makes 'the bob' the first bob, so I read it so.
